# Every command

Generated from the command tree, so a command cannot exist without a row
here. The reference column points at the section that documents it; the
`Short` text is the command's own, as `morzer --help` prints it.

| Command | What it does | Reference |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `morzer init` | Create a new installation | [commands](commands.md#init) |
| `morzer apply` | Converge the system to the installed release | [commands](commands.md#apply) |
| `morzer status` | Show what is deployed and whether it is working | [commands](commands.md#status) |
| `morzer update` | Install a new release over the current one | [commands](commands.md#update) |
| `morzer rollback` | Return to the previous release | [commands](commands.md#rollback) |
| `morzer config` | Read and change the release parameters | [parameters](parameters.md#changing-one-after-install) |
| `morzer config list` (also `ls`) | Show every parameter the release declares | [parameters](parameters.md#changing-one-after-install) |
| `morzer config get` | Print one parameter's effective value | [parameters](parameters.md#changing-one-after-install) |
| `morzer config set` | Change one or more parameters, or an installation setting | [parameters](parameters.md#changing-one-after-install) |
| `morzer config unset` | Return parameters or a setting to their defaults | [parameters](parameters.md#changing-one-after-install) |
| `morzer config settings` | Show the installation settings and their values | [parameters](parameters.md#changing-one-after-install) |
| `morzer secret` | Manage the encrypted secret state | [secret-commands](secret-commands.md#morzer-secret) |
| `morzer secret list` | List secret names, fingerprints and metadata — never values | [secret-commands](secret-commands.md#secret-list) |
| `morzer secret set` | Set a secret, reading the value from the terminal or stdin | [secret-commands](secret-commands.md#secret-set) |
| `morzer secret generate` | Generate a secret using the release's declared generator | [secret-commands](secret-commands.md#secret-generate) |
| `morzer secret remove` | Delete a secret | [secret-commands](secret-commands.md#secret-remove) |
| `morzer secret rotate` | Replace a secret with a freshly generated value | [secret-commands](secret-commands.md#secret-rotate) |
| `morzer secret edit` | Edit several secrets in one editor session | [secret-commands](secret-commands.md#secret-edit) |
| `morzer secret render` | Render secrets to the tmpfs directory the product reads | [secret-commands](secret-commands.md#secret-render) |
| `morzer secret recipients` | Manage who can decrypt the secret state | [secret-commands](secret-commands.md#secret-recipients) |
| `morzer secret recipients list` | List recipients | [secret-commands](secret-commands.md#secret-recipients-list) |
| `morzer secret recipients add` | Add a recipient and re-encrypt the state for it | [secret-commands](secret-commands.md#secret-recipients-add) |
| `morzer secret recipients remove` | Remove a recipient and re-encrypt without it | [secret-commands](secret-commands.md#secret-recipients-remove) |
| `morzer secret recipients generate-recovery-key` | Create an offline recovery identity; show its public key | [secret-commands](secret-commands.md#secret-recipients-generate-recovery-key) |
| `morzer doctor` | Run read-only diagnostics | [commands](commands.md#doctor) |
| `morzer logs` | Read the deployment's logs | [commands](commands.md#logs) |
| `morzer ps` | List the deployment's containers | [commands](commands.md#ps) |
| `morzer stats` | Show CPU, memory and I/O per container | [commands](commands.md#stats) |
| `morzer exec` | Run a command inside a running service | [commands](commands.md#exec) |
| `morzer backup` | Back up the database, volumes, configuration and secret state | [commands](commands.md#backup) |
| `morzer backup list` | List backups, newest first | [commands](commands.md#backup-list) |
| `morzer backup verify` | Re-read a backup and check its checksums | [commands](commands.md#backup-verify) |
| `morzer backup target` | Manage where backups are kept besides this machine | [commands](commands.md#backup-target) |
| `morzer backup target add` | Add a backup target | [commands](commands.md#backup-target) |
| `morzer backup target remove` | Stop keeping backups at a target | [commands](commands.md#backup-target) |
| `morzer backup target list` | List backup targets and whether they can be reached | [commands](commands.md#backup-target) |
| `morzer backup push` | Copy an existing backup to every configured target | [commands](commands.md#backup-push) |
| `morzer backup fetch` | Copy a backup down from a target onto this machine | [commands](commands.md#backup-fetch) |
| `morzer restore` | Restore from a backup | [commands](commands.md#restore) |
| `morzer release` | Inspect and manage release bundles | [release-commands](release-commands.md#morzer-release) |
| `morzer release list` | List installed releases, newest first | [release-commands](release-commands.md#release-list) |
| `morzer release show` | Show a release manifest; the installed one when no version is given | [release-commands](release-commands.md#release-show) |
| `morzer release new` | Scaffold a bundle skeleton that already verifies | [release-commands](release-commands.md#release-new) |
| `morzer release verify` | Validate a bundle's manifest and check its integrity | [release-commands](release-commands.md#release-verify) |
| `morzer release pack` | Copy the images a manifest marks `from: bundle` into the bundle | [release-commands](release-commands.md#release-pack) |
| `morzer release build` | Stamp a version, regenerate the checksum list, and check the result | [release-commands](release-commands.md#release-build) |
| `morzer release archive` | Pack a bundle directory into a release archive | [release-commands](release-commands.md#release-archive) |
| `morzer release fetch` | Fetch a release bundle into the release store | [release-commands](release-commands.md#release-fetch) |
| `morzer release ingest` | Load the images the installed release carries into the local store | [release-commands](release-commands.md#release-ingest) |
| `morzer release prune` | Remove old releases beyond the retention policy | [release-commands](release-commands.md#release-prune) |
| `morzer ls` | List the installations on this machine | [installation-commands](installation-commands.md#installation-list) |
| `morzer installation` | List, export and rebuild the installations on this machine | [installation-commands](installation-commands.md#morzer-installation) |
| `morzer installation list` | List the installations on this machine | [installation-commands](installation-commands.md#installation-list) |
| `morzer installation export` | Write the installation identity and encrypted secrets to a file | [installation-commands](installation-commands.md#installation-export) |
| `morzer installation import` | Rebuild this machine from an export and an offline recovery key | [installation-commands](installation-commands.md#installation-import) |
| `morzer version` | Print version, commit, and supported manifest API versions | [commands](commands.md#version) |
| `morzer completion install` | Write the completion script where this shell will read it | [commands](commands.md#completion-install) |
